data.name: CCT 是近似黑体轨迹上的最近投影，范围 1667–25000 K；轨迹距离大于 0.05 或落在范围端点时不报告。主波长使用参考白点向样品的射线与光谱轨迹交点；紫色区域报告反方向的补色波长。纯度为白点至样品距离 / 白点至边界距离，紫色区域使用紫线边界。白点自身、无效色坐标或光谱边界外不报告波长。图面颜色仅为屏幕示意。
data.value: CCT uses the nearest projection onto an approximate blackbody locus from 1667–25000 K. No value is reported when the locus distance exceeds 0.05 or the projection reaches a range endpoint. Dominant wavelength uses the intersection of the ray from reference white through the sample with the spectral locus. In the purple region, the complementary wavelength is reported in the opposite direction. Purity is the white-to-sample distance divided by the white-to-boundary distance, using the purple line boundary in the purple region. Wavelength is not reported for the white point itself, invalid chromaticities, or points outside the spectral boundary. Diagram colors are illustrative screen colors only.

data.name: CSV / Excel TSV 支持带表头的 Space,V1,V2,V3 格式，以及 X,Y,Z 或 x,y,Y 或 x,y 简表（区分大小写）。Name、Group、Source、Basis 可选；Basis 为 Relative、Absolute、ChromaticityOnly，默认 Relative。小数点使用 .，不解析公式。整批验证后才加入；最多 5000 点。CSV 保存 XYZ 原值与色差结果，JSON 会话另存参考样品、白点与图层条件。筛选只影响图和表的显示，批量统计及导出使用全部样品。报告为含图像的离线 HTML，可在浏览器打印。色域页的输入和结果独立导出，不包含在样品会话中。
data.value: CSV / Excel TSV supports headers Space,V1,V2,V3 and case-sensitive short forms X,Y,Z, x,y,Y, or x,y. Name, Group, Source, and Basis are optional. Basis accepts Relative, Absolute, or ChromaticityOnly and defaults to Relative. Use a decimal point (.) and no formulas. A batch is added only after complete validation, with up to 5000 points. CSV preserves original XYZ and color difference results; JSON sessions also save the reference sample, white point, and layer conditions. Filtering affects only the diagram and table; batch statistics and exports use all samples. Reports are offline HTML with images and can be printed from a browser. Gamut inputs and results are exported separately and are not included in sample sessions.

data.name: ΔE76 为 CIELAB 欧氏距离；ΔEuv 为 CIELUV 欧氏距离；ΔE00 使用 CIEDE2000，kL=kC=kH=1；ΔE94 使用 graphic arts 参数；CMC 分别显示 1:1 与 2:1。CIE94 / CMC 具有方向性，以设定的参考样品作为公式中的第一色。所有样品使用相同白点，不自动做色适应。ΔE00 阈值用于比较，不代表任何行业认证。
data.value: ΔE76 is Euclidean distance in CIELAB; ΔEuv is Euclidean distance in CIELUV. ΔE00 uses CIEDE2000 with kL=kC=kH=1. ΔE94 uses graphic arts parameters; CMC reports both 1:1 and 2:1. CIE94 / CMC are directional and use the reference sample as the first color. All samples share one white point without automatic chromatic adaptation. The ΔE00 threshold is for comparison and does not represent industry certification.

data.name: Δu′v′ 是两个样品在 CIE 1976 平面的距离；Duv 是单个样品到黑体轨迹在 CIE 1960 uv 平面的有符号距离，两者不能混用。JNCD=Δu′v′/步长，默认步长 0.004，仅为可修改的换算约定。
data.value: Δu′v′ is the distance between two samples in the CIE 1976 plane. Duv is the signed distance of one sample from the blackbody locus in the CIE 1960 uv plane; these quantities are not interchangeable. JNCD=Δu′v′/step, with a default step of 0.004, which is an adjustable conversion convention.

data.name: LSF · 加窗后的边缘导数

MTF 表示不同粗细细节保留的相对对比度。空间频率越高，细节越细。
MTF50 / MTF10 是响应降到 50% / 10% 时的频率，不是清晰度分数。— 表示无效或在 0..0.5 cy/pixel 范围内未达到阈值，请看状态列。MTF@频率则是指定频率的响应比例。
Nyquist = 0.5 cy/pixel。超出部分用于诊断，不能解释为无混叠分辨能力。曲线超过 1 可能与锐化有关，不会自动裁掉。
ESF 显示亮暗边缘过渡；LSF 是其导数，本窗口显示用于计算的加窗 LSF。平台不平、多峰或振铃有助于解释异常。
显示屏 RGB 子像素被解析出来时，平台纹理与两套像素栅格可能影响结果。请检查原始 ROI、方向、曝光和拍摄尺度；自动模糊或周期平均会改变测量响应，不能当作无代价的修复。
当前结果是单张图像的系统响应。没有连续原始帧时不能判断采集重复性；也不能直接当作镜头自身的 MTF。
data.value:
MTF represents the relative contrast retained at different detail scales. Higher spatial frequencies represent finer detail.
MTF50 / MTF10 are the frequencies where response falls to 50% / 10%, not sharpness scores. — indicates an invalid result or a threshold not reached within 0..0.5 cy/pixel; check the status column. MTF at a frequency is the response ratio at that frequency.
Nyquist = 0.5 cy/pixel. Data beyond it is diagnostic and does not indicate alias-free resolving power. Curves above 1 may relate to sharpening and are not automatically clipped.
ESF shows the light-to-dark edge transition; LSF is its derivative. This window displays the windowed LSF used in calculation. Uneven plateaus, multiple peaks, or ringing help explain anomalies.
When display RGB subpixels are resolved, plateau texture and two pixel grids may affect results. Inspect the original ROI, direction, exposure, and capture scale. Automatic blur or periodic averaging changes the measurement response and is not a cost-free correction.
The current result is the system response from one image. Acquisition repeatability cannot be assessed without consecutive original frames; the result cannot be treated directly as the lens's own MTF.
